description: Edits a text file inside the allowed folders. action replace (the default) swaps exact text old for new (old must match once, or set all); lines replaces lines start..end with new (empty new deletes them; take the numbers from cat); insert puts new after line (0 = top); write creates or overwrites the whole file with new. Shows the changed lines afterwards. Cannot change the tools folder or .git folders.

params.name: path
params.description: File to edit, starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump/src/main.c

params.name: old
params.description: replace: the exact text to replace, including indentation; include enough lines to make it unique

params.name: new
params.description: The new text: the replacement, the lines to put in, or the whole file for write

params.name: all
params.description: replace: change every occurrence of old instead of requiring exactly one

params.name: end
params.description: lines: last line to replace (default: start)

params.name: line
params.description: insert: the line to insert after; 0 inserts at the top
